notes:
Need to search first.I don't have any notes for you on Lamentations 3:45–66 yet, because my research never got started.

I tried to open the verse-by-verse pages on enduringword.com, preceptaustin.org and biblehub.com (Lamentations 3:45 and 3:53). The tool refused each request, since it only opens a page after that page has turned up in a search. I then tried to run searches on all the verses, and the tool reported that I had no more research calls left for this turn. No search results came back and I read no pages.

You asked me to report only what the pages say, with a link for every point, and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written anything from memory, not even what Gill, Ellicott or the Pulpit Commentary are often said to say about these verses.

To get this done:
- **Ask me again in a new message.** I'll search first and then read the pages: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, BibleHub commentaries for vv. 45–66, StudyLight, NET Bible notes, and the Catholic, Orthodox and tradition-specific sites. Then I'll write the notes verse by verse with links.
- **Or split it up** (for example vv. 45–54, then 55–58, then 59–66). Smaller requests are less likely to hit the limit.
- **Or paste in pages yourself** if you already have them open, and I'll write the notes from those.
